fieldValues.title: The Conversations view cannot affirm a persona-in-domain, so a derived persona stays suggested
fieldValues.summary: In holon #49's setup sitting the owner affirmed the problem (SP-130) and remedy beside their vignettes in the Method editor's Conversations view, but the persona-in-domain 5a603ae9 offered no tick: the view's affirm act covers problem, remedy, cluster and persona only (CARRY in srs-web src/lib/method/method-document.ts). The owner affirmed it by another route (srs-programme#344).
evidence: srs-web src/lib/method/method-document.ts CARRY: problem, remedy, cluster, persona
fieldValues.body:
- Every problem is held-by a persona-in-domain, so the commonest derived persona is exactly the one the view cannot tick.
- Suggested change: add persona-in-domain to the Method editor's affirmable entities.
